Why book direct

Skip the platform markup. Keep the same host.

You are booking the same Jenkintown apartments from the same Airbnb-reviewed host, through our secure direct calendar. The difference is that you are not paying the marked-up platform price.

About $70 less 4-night Cozy Spot example: $400 stay + $100 cleaning + $40 tax = $540 direct. The comparable platform price is about $610. That leaves about $70 in your pocket. Taxes apply either way; the savings come from booking direct.
